# @llmnative/agentico

> Agentic chat orchestrator for @llmnative/react apps. A persistent panel: the orchestrator
> collects parameters in conversation and hands the work to host-registered subagents. Every
> subagent has a deterministic fallback. Agentico knows nothing concrete about the host.

## Host responsibilities (startup)

- `registerSubagents(manifests)` — SubagentManifest: id, label, icon, description, indexPath, commands (name, summary, Zod inputSchema, describeOutput), definition (AgentDefinition), toParams, destinationIds, optional crossAgentToolIds, withCollected, manualEntry, componentContexts, chatEntityId (chat saved at every turn under that entity), onlyWhenAnchored (offered by the orchestrator only when scoped to it).
- `registerDestinations({ id: ResultDestination })` — apply(result, { scopeId, dataProvider, storageProvider, proxyFetch }, meta).
- `registerSubagentReports({ subagentId: SubagentReportModule })`.
- `registerSubagentControls({ subagentId: useControls })` — a hook of the host per task (props: params, taskId, running, close) returning `{ actions?: ChatbotAction[] (with onClick), commands?: EditorCommand[], content?: ReactNode }`, memoized: actions in the prompt, slash commands on `/` (a command without handler inserts `/name `; the turn gets it as plain `text`, the host decides what it means; hidden while docked questions replace the composer), content above it.
- `SubagentManifest.onArchive(entityId, params)` / `confirmArchive(entityId, params)` — archiving a chat from the history (hover icon).
- `registerCrossAgentTools((ctx) => AgentTool[])` — ctx: attachmentsRef, collected (per-conversation scratchpad), proxyFetch.
- `configureAgenticoPrompts(partial)` — model-facing pack; `agenticoPromptsEn` (default) / `agenticoPromptsIt`.
- `configureEntityChatStore({ storageKey })`.
- i18n: merge `agenticoTranslations.<locale>` into `<App i18n={{ translations }}>`; override any `agentico.*` key.

## Mount

```tsx
<AgenticoProvider scope={{ id, dataProvider, storageProvider } | null}>
  <AgenticoToggle />
  <Agentico />
</AgenticoProvider>
```

`<Agentico defaultWidth? minWidth? maxWidth? onWidthChange? />` (0.4.0): the column is resized by dragging its inner edge (a `role="separator"`: arrows by 16 px, Shift ×4, Home/End, double click = default), clamped to `minWidth` (320) … `maxWidth` (px or `'<n>vw'`, default `'60vw'`), stored per browser under `agentico:panel-width`. Defaults `AGENTICO_WIDTH` (420), `AGENTICO_MIN_WIDTH`, `AGENTICO_MAX_WIDTH`. Unanswered questions of the latest agent message (turn not stopped/failed) are docked at the bottom in place of the composer (scroll inside, Stop while the turn runs), the person's message is not pinned meanwhile; once answered they are back in the thread, read-only. Questions of a reloaded chat are answerable (docked) too.

## Hooks

- `useAgentico()` — panel state, `startOrchestrator(goal, opts)`, `startSubagent(subagentId, params, { taskId?, openingMessage? })` (use `entityChatTaskId(subagentId, entityId)` as taskId), `resumeEntityChat`, `commitEntityChat(subagentId, entityId, taskId, scopeId, params, title)`, `scope`.
- `useAgenticoPageContext(text, card?)` — what the user is looking at.
- `useSubagentComponentContext(subagentId, componentKey)` — anchor a component to a subagent.
- `useAgent(definition)` — run an AgentDefinition directly.

## AgentDefinition

buildContext (always runs) · buildPrompt · buildFollowUpPrompt · parseResponse (null → fallback) · fallback (required) · describeFallback? · getTools? · microPromptIds? · conversational? · executor?

`conversational: true` (0.6.0): each text reply of the model is a text part of its turn (a message of the chat), and the subagent keeps no result: no preview, no destinations under the chat. For a chat with tools and nothing to apply.

`AgentTool.needsApproval: true | (input) => boolean` (0.7.0): the call waits for the person on a docked question "Approve? <describeApproval(input)>" (Approve / Reject + reason); rejected, the tool does not run and the model reads the prompt `toolRejected` with the reason.

`executor.turn({ params, context, text, first, signal, model?, onText(whole reply so far), onStep({ id, label, status }) }) → { text, result? }`; `executor.models(params)` / `defaultModel(params)` put the models of the executor in the composer: the turns go to the host instead of the AI provider; `text` is what the person typed (opening message on the first turn). The conversation is `remote: true`: no attachments, no fallback; the picker shows `remoteModels`.
CR-009: `executor.alongside: true` keeps the agent on the AI catalog (prompts, tools, approvals): only the turns whose model is one of `executor.models` go to `executor.turn` (`first` on its first one); the picker shows the executor's models (`{ label, value, group?, groupBadge?: { label, variant? } }`) then the catalog's, grouped by `executor.catalogGroup(provider, label) → { group, badge? }`; `useAgent` gives `alongside`, `catalogGroup`.
CR-010: `executor.catalogProviders(params) → string[] | undefined` limits the AI catalog of a chat to those providers (composer and turns; a model of another provider is never used: the executor's first model, else the first allowed one). A saved chat keeps `startedAt` (first save; `chatStartedAt(snapshot)` falls back to `savedAt`); `listEntityChats` lists the last started first and the history shows the start.
CR-017: `executor.attachments: true` offers attachments on the models of the executor; the turn gets `attachments: AIAttachment[]` (name, mimeType, base64). Going back sends the text again, not the files.
CR-016: Edit on a message of the person (on hover), Retry on one whose answer was cut (stopped, failed; also the Retry of the error bar): `useAgent().rewind(entryId, text?)` cuts the chat and the history of the model at that message (`entry.historyAt`) and sends it again; `canRewind` (always without an executor; with one, only if `executor.canRewind`), and its next turn carries `rewound: { activity }` (start again from the chat as it is). A confirmation lists the steps done after it (they stay done).
CR-015: `AgentDefinition.offersFallback: false` hides "Continue without AI" when the model fails (an agent with no result without a model, e.g. a chat); default shown.
CR-014: cards in messages — part `{ type: 'card', id, title, badge?, body?, details?, actions?: [{ id, label, icon?, variant? }], data?, outcome? }`; `AgentTool.card(input, output)` adds one after the tool ran, `turn.onCard(card)` for an executor; `AgentDefinition.onCardAction(params, card, actionId) → { status: 'done' | 'dismissed' | 'error', text, link? }` (stored in the card, buttons off); View opens `details` in a side modal; `useAgent().cardAction(entryId, partId, actionId)`.
CR-013: `configureEntityChatStore({ storageKey, backend })` — `EntityChatBackend { load(scopeId), save(snapshot), remove(scopeId, subagentId, entityId) }`: the browser copy stays (sync reads), writes also go to the backend; `syncEntityChats(scopeId)` (AgenticoProvider on scope change) merges by `changedAt`, drops chats gone remotely, sends never-sent ones; a refused removal comes back.
CR-012: `executor.catalogReasoning(params, provider) → 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'max' | undefined`: the turns of the chat on that provider of the catalog send `reasoning` on each request (@llmnative/react 1.46 maps it per provider).
CR-018: `SubagentManifest.thread(params)` makes the saved chats of the scope with the same key sessions of one chat: the panel shows the earlier ones above the open one, read-only (no questions, Retry or Edit), one more each time the person scrolls to the top or presses "Earlier session", each opened by a separator (title, start, "Continue this session" resumes it) and "This session" above the open one; the model reads only the open session. `SubagentManifest.speaker(params)` → `{ name, avatarUrl? }` puts the picture of the agent in a column on the left, its name next to it with a closed summary of the reasoning and steps before its text ("Reasoned for 4 s · 1 step", opened with a click), the text under them; `<AgenticoProvider person={{ name, avatarUrl? }}>` writes `author` on each message of the person (kept in the snapshot): their picture in the same column, Edit and Retry under it, the name above the full-width message; without a picture an `Identicon` of the name. `chatThreadOf(snapshot)`, `earlierSessions(scopeId, thread, openTaskId)`.
CR-019: `<AgenticoProvider threadEvents={source}>` (keep it memoized): `source.load(thread, from, to)` → `ThreadEvent[]` (`id`, `at` ms, `author` ChatAuthor, `title`, optional `body` Markdown, `badge`, `href`, `icon`), optional `source.subscribe(thread, onChange)` → unsubscribe. In a chat with a `thread` the panel shows them among the turns by time (`placeEvents`), as compact cards with the author's picture in the left column (opened: the body; a link to `href`); the open session from the last message of the session before it, each earlier one up to its last message. Header filter "Conversation only" (kept in this browser, `llmnative.agentico.threadEvents`). The model never reads them. Every entry of a chat now keeps `at` (when it was born); entries saved before 0.18.0 have none.
CR-020: the images attached to a message of the person stay in sight as previews (`entry.attachmentPreviews`: JPEG data URLs of at most 480 px a side, the first 4 images, drawn in the browser by `imagePreviews(files)` and kept with the chat); a click opens one larger; files without a preview stay as their names. `ThreadEvent.running: true` shows a spinner in place of its icon (an agent still at work on it).
CR-021: `ThreadEvent.open: true` shows its body at once; `ThreadEvent.actions: [{ id, label, icon?, primary? }]` are buttons on its card, run by `ThreadEventsSource.onAction(event, actionId, chat)`: `chat.compose(text)` puts a text in the field of the chat open in the panel (the person changes and sends it), `chat.send(text)` sends it as a message of the person (composed instead while a turn runs). `useAgentico().compose(text)` does the same anywhere (it opens the panel).
CR-011: `SubagentManifest.autoTitle: true` gives its saved chats a title from the model (after a turn; once per session for older ones; a model of the catalog the chat may use), drops conversational chats where the person never wrote; `snapshot.name`/`namedBy`, `chatTitle(snapshot)`, `renameEntityChat(scopeId, subagentId, entityId, title, 'person' | 'model')` (the person's wins; empty resets), `onEntityChatsChange(listener)`; the history has Rename.

Message parts (0.3.0): the turn also has `onText(text, { id?, done? })` (without id: the one reply, kept below steps and reasoning; with id: a text part of its own), `onReasoning(text, { id?, done?, duration? })` (whole text so far; shown closed, "Reasoned for N s", duration measured if not given), `onQuestions(questions, { id? }) → Promise<answers>` (questions `{ id?, header?, question, options?: [{ label, description? }], multiple?, recommended?, custom? }`; answers `[{ id?, header?, values: string[] }]`). Answers given while the turn runs resolve that promise; given later (or after a reload) they start a new turn with `text: ''` and `answers: { id, answers }` (id = the questions part id, default `questions-N`). Parts are kept in `AgentActivityEntry.parts` (`text` | `reasoning` | `tool` | `questions`, `detail` = the text) and saved with the chat; old chats without parts show `detail`. Rendered with `ChatMarkdown`, `ChatReasoning`, steps grouped in a `Tree`, `ChatQuestions` (needs `@llmnative/react` 1.34). `useAgent().answerQuestions(entryId, partId, answers)`.
